crossRefs.note: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
Demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t…
As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by…

translations.web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
translations.bsb: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
translations.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
translations.asv: And he healed many that were sick with divers diseases, and cast out many demons; and he suffered not the demons to speak, because they knew him.
